description: Baselines for the XCTest performance suite (#73) on one machine type; see docs/performance.md.

recorded.note: GitHub Actions xcode-27 runner (Apple silicon VM), iPhone 17 simulator, iOS 27.0, Release with BLAU_PERF; three runs pooled: CI runs 37705297862, 37705304118, 37705309835

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_ApplicationLaunch.name: Duration (AppLaunch)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_ApplicationLaunch.note: Hand-set from every CI run so far: launch on the shared VMs is bimodal by host, median 4.3 to 5.5 s on some hosts and 7.3 to 8.4 s on others (runs 37645399395, 37691777269), so only a gross regression (a synchronous load at launch) trips it. The device launch numbers are the baseline that matters (docs/performance.md).

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_CPU-com.joeblau.b.name: CPU Time (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_CPU-com.joeblau.b.note: The idle app uses about a millisecond of CPU in 10 s, so percentages are meaningless; changes under 20 ms (0.2% of a core) are ignored. The HUD's own budget is checked against the shown run.

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_CPU-com.joeblau.b.name: CPU Time (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_CPU-com.joeblau.b.note: Calibrated: run medians strayed up to 33% from the pooled baseline across 3 runs on this machine type, so the tolerance is 1.5 times that.

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_CPU-com.joeblau.b.name: CPU Time (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_CPU-com.joeblau.b.note: Hand-set: CPU time of identical code moves with the CI host, by 23% between these three runs and 33% between two earlier ones (3.23 s and 4.31 s, runs 37674414639 and 37691777269). The VM has no instruction counter, so a 10% CPU gate needs a Mac or device baseline; in CI the micro-benchmarks gate CPU-heavy code paths on every pull request.

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.name: Memory Physical (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.note: The memory a session leaves behind: a few hundred kB either way, so changes under 2 MB are noise.

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.name: Absolute Memory Physical (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.note: Steady within a host (under 1%), but bimodal across runner hosts: about 38 MB on most, 31 MB on some (CI run 37712507805, and the simulator on an M3 Max). The baseline sits on the higher mode, so on a 31 MB host a regression has to pass about 35% before it trips the 10% gate.

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.name: Memory Peak Physical (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.note: Steady within a host (under 1%), but bimodal across runner hosts: about 38 MB on most, 31 MB on some (CI run 37712507805, and the simulator on an M3 Max). com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_OSSignpost-db.sav.name: Duration (db.save)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_OSSignpost-db.sav.note: XCTOSSignpostMetric reports one interval per iteration, not the session's total, so it swings far more than 10% between runs; gated only against gross regressions. The session's CPU and memory metrics carry the 10% gate.
